cohort_station_ids.semantics: Compare the membership set; semicolon/comma/whitespace separators and member order are presentation equivalents. Preserve individual identifiers. Repeated identical members do not add membership.

precision: Round source computations HALF_UP to 2dp; compare predicted decimals exactly without further rounding or tolerance. Equivalent trailing zeros/explicit equivalent units allowed.
duplicates: First occurrence eligible for credit; all duplicate rows count in denominator, no extra reward.
sorting: withdrawn activity ID, start year, end year; P.O.A. on complete scenario/interval identities; fewer2common=>0
missing: Blank/absent output values incorrect; missing rows penalized; NONE parsed as empty; nonempty unparsable unscored and reported.
sentinels: Declared empty-post-frontier sentinel is meaningful missing data; NONE/NA exactly as public task. Actual source recomputation determines whether any exists.
